rationale: Roberts is most likely to keep the majority together by writing a narrow opinion upholding the rule chiefly as applied to clearly “readily convertible” kits under § 921(a)(3)(A) while rejecting any broad redefinition of “frame or receiver” under (B). Thomas is most likely to write the principal dissent (with Gorsuch and likely Alito joining in whole or part), while one or more majority Justices (especially Barrett/Kagan/Kavanaugh) may concur to emphasize limiting principles, lenity/fair-notice constraints, and the remedial significance of the Court’s prior “insofar as” stay.
